# starting a company

Infrastructure Surface Management will never be the same.

- Data needs to be composed of the right primitives
- Every application should be built for consumption by agents first
- Deviations are always required, accountability is key
- AI is transforming the industry but context and capabilities will be required for the foreeable future

# things with names

Naming things in computer science has always been hard. This holds especially true when we're talking about *host names*.

A hostname is often conflated with a FQDN, TLS SNI entry, HTTP Host, DNS zone, local hostfile mapping to IP address and a whole lot more. It's time someone writes an article about this to try and clear up the confusion...

## more about me

```rust
fn main() {
    let me = Person::new("Mathijs");
    me.whoami();
}

struct Person {
    name: &'static str,
}

impl Person {
    /// Who am I, what am I doing here?
    fn new(name: &'static str) -> Self {
        Self { name }
    }

    /// Maybe the answer is here?
    fn whoami(&self) {
        println!("Hi, I'm {}!", self.name);
    }
}
```
